components.text: $(blood)Life Essence$() is all fine and good in the Blood Altar, where it can be used for crafting or funnelled into an Orb to power Rituals, but what if you want to build a moat of the stuff? Fortunately, extracting Life Essence is relatively trivial: simply place a Bucket in the Blood Altar and wait a few seconds for it to fill up. $(blood)1 LP$() = 1mb, so $(blood)1,000 LP$() should be plenty for a full bucket.
